caption: The drawing is a technical illustration of a sofa, rendered in black ink on an off-white or beige paper background. The sheet is divided into three cartesian grid sections, showing three distinct views of the sofa: a front elevation at the top, a side profile view at the bottom left, and a top-down plan view at the bottom right. The sofa features a high, ornate backrest with a scalloped and heart-like outline, flaring arms, and intricately carved wood details at the crest and center of the front lower rail. The seat appears to be upholstered and has a rounded, undulating front edge. All three views are meticulously labeled with dimensions in inches, and scale bars along the bottom and top edges denote the scale of each diagram. The sofa stands on four cabriole legs, with the front legs more prominently curved and decorated. The drawing’s composition is precise and balanced, with clean, thin lines and clear, handwritten measurement notations throughout.
title: Sofa
